'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Brazil wildfires]]
**Wildfires burn 760,000 hectares (1.8 million acres) of the [[Brazil]]ian [[Pantanal]], destroying over 4% of Brazil's largest [[wetland]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/article/2024/jul/09/devastation-as-worlds-biggest-wetland-burns-those-that-cannot-run-dont-stand-a-chance-brazil-pantanal (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2024 Sulawesi landslide]]
**The death toll from the collapse of an illegal [[Gold mining|gold mine]] in [[Bone Bolango]], [[Indonesia]], amid heavy rains, increases to 23 people. Thirty-five others are still missing and 23 more were rescued. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-landslide-illegal-gold-mining-713e6f09762dc1de6c0523850a5dde82 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Ethiopia–Sudan relations]], [[Sudanese peace process]]
**[[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Ethiopian Prime Minister]] [[Abiy Ahmed]] meets in [[Port Sudan]] with [[Sudan|Sudanese]] [[Transitional Sovereignty Council]] leader and [[Sudanese Armed Forces|armed forces]] commander [[Abdel Fattah al-Burhan]] to seek an end to the [[Sudanese civil war (2023-present)|Sudanese Civil War]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article288018/ (Sudan Tribune)]
*[[Georgia–European Union relations]], [[Accession of Georgia to the European Union]]
**The [[European Union]] pauses the [[Accession of Georgia to the European Union|accession]] of [[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] to the organization and freezes €30 million (US$32.5 million) in aid to the Georgian [[Ministry of Defence of Georgia|Ministry of Defense]] after the [[Parliament of Georgia|Georgian parliament]] [[2023–2024 Georgian protests|passed a law]] requiring media and nonprofit groups to be deemed as [[foreign agent]]s if they receive more than 20% of their funding from foreign sources. [https://apnews.com/article/georgia-eu-membership-foreign-agents-law-b812e27d5ddba6e03d8859652b8fc986 (AP)]
*[[Hungary–Russia relations]], [[Foreign relations of Belarus]], [[Russia–European Union relations]]
**[[Hungary]] opens its borders to [[Russia|Russian]] and [[Belarus|Belarusian]] [[Foreign worker|guest workers]] without requiring [[Work permit|work visa]]s or cultural knowledge testing requirements, thereby allowing these workers to obtain "National Cards" and travel freely within the [[European Union]]'s [[Schengen Area]]. [https://www.forbes.hu/tarsadalom/orosz-belarusz-vendegmunkas-magyarorszag-racz-andras/ (Forbes)]
*[[Ukraine–NATO relations]]
**[[NATO]] announces that it will establish a senior representative to [[Kyiv]] to coordinate with [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] officials and strengthen Ukraine's ties to NATO. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/7/9/nato-to-appoint-representative-in-kyiv-to-deepen-ukraine-ties-us-official (Al Jazeera)]
